$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the five checks are rendered as five steps, one per check, each running tea-evaluate ci --tier pr. The command runs every check of the tier, so the whole tier then runs five times.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean, but the tier command is invoked by five run: blocks where one is expected, so the tier step element misses. Everything else is present.

elementMisses: command-evaluation-ci-pr: 5 run: blocks invoke npm exec --prefix evals -- tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr, expected one
